run frozen exact-world validation, training/prior-panel identity overlap audits, fresh LFM feature extraction and radius-only matching
materialize and hash the nine-run schedule and prospective checkpoint manifest
implement and hash P-specific trainer, evaluator, checkpoint/prediction writers, and analysis reader
